input.body: We are writing to request a review of a $16.50 deduction on order DD-48267, dated 2026-11-07. The reason given was a missing item, the Peanut Butter Bowl. The order ticket lists the Peanut Butter Bowl, which shows the order was received and prepared as placed [DD-48267:ticket_lists_item]. We note that the ticket alone does not show what was packed. The order was ready at 12:52 and picked up at 12:55, a 3-minute interval before handoff to the courier [DD-48267:pickup_handoff]. Based on this, we ask that the deduction be reviewed and, if the records support it, reversed. We are glad to provide further information on request. Thank you for your time.
